key_findings: NLRP3 inhibitor dapansutrile reduced severity of cyclophosphamide-induced cystitis in mice.
Dap lowered bladder NLRP3, caspase-1, IL-1beta, NF-kB and iNOS, systemic cytokines including TNF-alpha, and bladder CXCR3+ T cells, mast cells and neutrophils.
